summary.classification: One interior data territory between code regions: a font/glyph asset block (rodata strings + glyph/charset codepoint remap map + per-glyph width table + a dense 16-bit remap LUT [1456 u16] + a packed graphics blob) followed by three 0x801A/0x801B/0x801C-band RAM-pointer/jump tables interleaved with IEEE float64/float32 constant + record pools.

evidence: 3 all-zero align words (00000000 x3) preceding the string pool.
Two NUL-terminated ASCII strings "%s has changed class." @0x211D20 and "Supportive Attack" @0x211D38, plus trailing NUL alignment padding to 0x211D5C.

Large dense packed binary parameter/record block to region end. Interleaves float32 scalars (e.g. 0x46000006=8192.0f @0x211D98, 0x80008000 little fields), small u8/u16 integer fields, and embedded byte-ramp index tables: 01 02 03 04 / 07 08 07 08 / 0D 0E 0D 0E run @0x211F44-0x211F9C and ascending 01 01 02 12 / 03 04 04 05 / 05 01 06 09 ramps @0x212180-0x212238, then a trailing small-int/0xFF block @0x212240-0x2122A0. Recurring 16-byte motif (E3..01 sc-looking words with 00 padding, then FC..xx and 80008000) suggests a fixed-stride little-record table but exact field layout is unconfirmed; not a code region (no prologue/epilogue, branch/jr decodes are coincidental).

Glyph/charset codepoint REMAP table (a 0x00..0x1F byte ramp then an ASCII-ordered glyph map with duplicates and small gaps; printable bytes form " !\"#$%&...XYZ[\]^_`abcd", NUL-terminated). Non-monotone remap, not a clean ASCII ramp.

Per-glyph width/flag byte table: small byte values (00,01,02,03,04 mixed with nul gaps), e.g. 0x212370=0x01030302, 0x21237C=0x04030302, 0x212380=0x03030303. Interleaved with short zero runs. 80 bytes (20 words).
Dense 16-bit index/remap LUT: 1456 u16 entries (728 words), all in band 0x0000..0x02CE (max 0x2CE), font/tile remap.

Packed/compressed graphics blob (font tile bitmaps). High-entropy bytes with distinctive run/RLE markers: repeated 0xDDDDDDDD / 0xBBBBBBBB / 0xDDDBBBBD fills (0x212FE8-0x213088), zero-run separators, and trailing E7000000 / E3000xxx / DF000000 / FF000000 patterned control words (0x213088-0x213118) resembling RLE control codes; ends 0x21311C=0x020100FF. Leading sub-block 0x212F00-0x212FC8 mixes small counts (0x0001,0x0020,0x0016,0x002C) with packed nibble data. Stride/codec not fully typed. 0x220 bytes.

24 words of small packed byte/index data, not pointers. Bytes (BE): FFFF0001 02000000 06030007 04010805 02000000 08070605 04030201 00000000 02050801 04070003 06000000, then zeros, then 00000400 02000000 00000400 02000000 00020000 01020000 00100000 00000000. Looks like small byte-index/parameter tables (stride unclear).
44 x u32 RAM pointers, 0x801A band (range 0x801ADEC4..0x801AE824). Many repeated entries (0x801AE460 x6, 0x801AE824 many) -> index-indexed dispatch/lookup table.
f64 const pool: 0x400921FB54442D18 = pi (x2) separated/followed by 0xC056800000000000 = -90.0 and a 0.0 pad word pair.
16 x u32 RAM pointers, 0x801AF2xx band (0x801AF290..0x801AF2B4); 8x repeat of 0x801AF2B4 then 0x801AF2B0/2A0/2A8/290/298/2A0/2A8. Final word 0x0A000000 (stray/filler index) included.
f64 const pool: 0x3FF199999999999A = 1.1 (three copies).
160 x u32 RAM pointers, 0x801B3-0x801B45 band (0x801B3D48..0x801B45C4). Highly repetitive 4-wide blocks (e.g. 0x801B3D48 x4, 0x801B3D50 x4) -> 2D/strided index-indexed dispatch table.

42 x u32 RAM pointers, 0x801B7Axx band (0x801B7A30..0x801B7A68). Dominated by repeated 0x801B7A68 sentinel with sparse distinct entries (0x801B7A30/38/40/48/50/58/60) -> index-indexed lookup with default.
16-byte all-zero gap between pointer table and following f64 constant.
72 x u32 RAM pointers, 0x801BC7-0x801BC9 band (0x801BC7D4..0x801BC994). Repetitive blocks (0x801BC7D4/7DC, 0x801BC8B0/8B8, 0x801BC98C/994) -> index-indexed dispatch/lookup table. Region end.
4 words all-zero leading pad (.word 0x00000000 x4).

IEEE float64 constant/record pool. Big-endian doubles: 0x3FC9999999999A=0.2, 0.0, 0x3FD322D0E5604189=0.3, 0x3FE2C8B439581062=~0.587, 0x3FBD2F1A9FBE76C9=~0.114, 0x3FE0..=0.5, 0x41E0..=2147483648.0. The 5-double record {0.3, ~0.587, ~0.114, 0.5, 2147483648.0} repeats; ends with 2-word zero pad (0x213828..0x213830).
Four int32 scalar constants: 0x000003E8=1000, 0x000003E8=1000, 0xFFFFFC18=-1000, 0xFFFFFC18=-1000.

RAM-pointer table, 128 words (u32). All values in 0x801C band: 0x801C285C..0x801C7604 (grouped runs e.g. 0x801C28xx, 0x801C2Fxx, 0x801C37xx, 0x801C42xx, 0x801C43xx, 0x801C44xx, 0x801C4Axx, 0x801C54xx, 0x801C75xx). Final word 0x213A3C is a 0x00000000 trailing nop pad within the block.

IEEE float64 record pool, three 5-double records. Big-endian doubles per record: 0x3FCA9FBE76C8B439=~0.208, 0x3FD80000..=1.5, 0x3FD80000..=1.5, 0x3FE40000..=0.625, 0x3FE40000..=0.625, 0x3FE94FDF3B645A1D=~0.79. Record repeats x3; ends with 4-word zero pad (0x213AD0..0x213AE0).
